semantic.justification: V4DQJW adds native FastSaxSerializer/FastSerializerHelper text/byte export, original1MiB cache, ordered token/value emission, XML10 and literal x-escape rules, APPEND/PREPEND/POSTPONE marks and original sorted buckets. XmlFilterBase now owns the native fragment-serializer factory with original no-header/VML/+xml predicate. Actual ZipFragmentStream/ZipStorage, OOXML token names and relationship/content-type owners are reused. Caller-provided actual FastTokenHandler replaces native component-service acquisition; no fake global context or token catalog is introduced. UTF16 host strings use the existing UTF8 byte transport binding; no exact claim is made for invalid UTF16 conversion or malformed UTF8 diagnostics. Native debug structural stacks remain unported; output preconditions retain the existing transport errors. File-local native invalidChar is exported only for source-scoped algorithm testing. Native numeric/double overloads and complete DOCX/XLSX export orchestration remain pending. No document/file UI behavior or whole-native parity is claimed; previous statuses and intentional file workflows remain unchanged. Native full FastAttributeList export overload now preserves queued variadic values and the VML raw-prefix XML-escaping bypass. Parser/unknown-attribute and complete format orchestration remain unported. Native serializer byte owners now use genuine SAL ByteSequence/NODEFAULT cache storage, raw nElements mutation and toUnoSequence output aliases. ForMerge/ForSort own actual native sequence values, preserve native realloc/prepend/postpone/sort behavior and copy the merge value before pop. Stack/cache std::shared_ptr lifetime is explicitly lowered to a private local control count with virtual destruction, including failed destination switches. Helper endDocument destroys its moved serializer on success or error. ZipFragmentStream and relationship export consume initialized UNO byte Sequence values; host Uint8Array chunks remain only at the ZIP transport copy boundary. WRITER137/CALC-303 has a local retained-native-value alias witness without a COW correction. Full native output Reference/OWriteStream/parent storage/transaction/service and DOCX/XLSX model/filter/Worker/UI acceptance remain unfinished. Numeric/encoding edge cases, physical allocation/ABI/shared_ptr layout and debug-only guarantees stay unverified. Browser file/persistence policy is unchanged.
